newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: CDL Hotels may spin off hotels - paper.
newsitem.headline: CDL Hotels may spin off hotels - paper.

text.p: CDL Hotels International Ltd, the Hong Kong-listed arm of Singapore's Hong Leong group, may spin off hotels worth more than HK$10 billion into a new company to be listed in Hong Kong, the Business Times said on Thursday.
The newspaper quoted CDP executive director Gan Khai Choon as saying any flotation was likely to take place in the second half of 1997.
"We are studying the feasibility with a number of investment bankers. The new company could be a Hong Kong-China or East Asian hotel play," Gan was quoted as saying.
He said CDL would continue to retain its listing in Hong Kong even after the new listing.
Earlier this year CDL listed its Millennium & Copthorne Hotels Plc unit on the London Stock Exchange.
CDL recently led a consortium which acquired a majority stake in the five-star Marriott Hotel in Hong Kong.
CDL is one of the world's 25 biggest hotel chains with 55 hotels in some 11 countries.
